title: Bug: model-availability-helper.sh resolve opus returns opencode/claude-opus-4-6 instead of anthropic/claude-opus-4-6
body: Observed: model-availability-helper.sh resolve opus returns 'opencode/claude-opus-4-6' but the correct provider prefix for OpenCode is 'anthropic/'. Workers dispatched with --model opencode/claude-opus-4-6 fail immediately with ProviderModelNotFoundError. The correct model ID is anthropic/claude-opus-4-6. Root cause hypothesis: the model-availability-helper has an incorrect provider prefix mapping for the opus tier. Proposed fix: update the provider prefix in model-availability-helper.sh to use 'anthropic/' instead of 'opencode/' for Anthropic models.

title: Bug: model-availability-helper.sh returns opencode/ prefixed model IDs invalid for opencode runtime
body: Observed in pulse session 2026-03-27: model-availability-helper.sh resolve sonnet returns 'opencode/claude-sonnet-4-6' and resolve opus returns 'opencode/claude-opus-4-6'. These model IDs cause immediate worker failure with error 'Model not found: opencode/claude-sonnet-4-6'. The correct IDs for opencode runtime are 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6' and 'anthropic/claude-opus-4-20250514'. Root cause hypothesis: model-availability-helper.sh has a runtime-detection branch that incorrectly prefixes model IDs with 'opencode/' when running in OpenCode. Proposed fix: return provider-prefixed IDs (anthropic/) regardless of runtime, or add runtime-aware ID mapping that uses the correct format for each runtime.
